full_judgment: 8. The petitioner approached the District Administration for the payment of ground rent for the year of 1415 BS, which they refused to accept. This came as a surprise to the petitioners as the Mohal Shamil Jolkors were in fact settled in the name of the representatives of concerned villagers and accordingly SA Khatian was prepared and ground rent paid. On further inquiry the petitioners learnt that the respondent No. 1 instead of providing a guide-line for the management of the Mohal Shamil directed the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet to take steps as per the existing fishery Settlement Policy Guideline. The latest Policy guideline provides for leasing out the fisheries by negotiation and by tender. In the said guideline nothing was said with regard to the Mohal Shamil Jolkor and no such clarification was made under the said guideline. The petitioners also learnt that the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet was taking steps for leasing out the Mohal Shamil Jolkors by tender.
